maddeler.e:
اضطغنا (form VIII)
# اِضْطَغَنَا (iḍṭaḡanā) /idˤ.tˤa.ɣa.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# اِضْطَغَنَّا (iḍṭaḡannā) /idˤ.tˤa.ɣan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# اُضْطُغِنَا (uḍṭuḡinā) /udˤ.tˤu.ɣi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# اُضْطُغِنَّا (uḍṭuḡinnā) /udˤ.tˤu.ɣin.naː/: first-person pl
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
